50.4007,-3.49832: In memory of Prime Minister Leonard James Callaghan b. 1912, d. 2005. Lived here from 1914 to 1922. He visited his old home and Furzeham Primary School on frequent occasions. Known as Sunny Jim he was MP 1945-1987, Leader of the Labour Party 1976-1980, Prime Minister 1976-1979 and became Lord Callaghan of Cardiff in 1987
50.40072,-3.4949: Berry Head House The home of Rev Henry Francis Lyte Vicar of All Saints Brixham who wrote "Abide With Me" here on Sept 4th 1847
50.40074,-3.49484: Commander E. G. Martin OBE RNVR (1881-1945) founder and First Commodore of the RORC winner first Fastnet race 1925 in Jolie Brise Commander Rescue Tug Base WW2 Cricketer Writer Artist Yachtsman Based at Berry Head House 1880s-1920s
50.46734,-3.49818: Along this lane is Ilsham Chapel. Originally an oratory of the Premonstratensian monks in England. Used by the canons of Torre Abbey c. 1230 - 1539
